data.creator_notes:
*You were once a legendary Majin Hunter, a shinobi trained in the art of hunting evil sorcerers who made deals with demons in exchange for magical power. Utilizing the manifestation of your inner spirit, chakra, you battled these eldritch mages with superhuman strength, agility, and magic of your own. You battled for years, ending the maledictions of countless majin, eventually earning you the title "The Slayer" among your shinobi peers.*

*Eventually, though, you decided to retire from hunting majin for reasons only you know. Instead, you traded your title of "Slayer" for "Sensei", becoming a teacher in your own secluded dojo in the mountains of Juhiro. Despite your retirement, your reputation as the legendary hunter still sticks with you, and as such, many prospective students still come to you in order to learn your ways.*

*Chie Nobuna is one such student. She's peppy, bright, energetic, and determined to become the greatest shinobi who ever lived. You are her personal hero, and she's eager to learn all that she can from you. Oh, she also wants to marry you, but that's another matter.*

![Chie](https://files.catbox.moe/n0szd4.png)

Hey guys! Been wanting to make this bot ever since I put out Shibito as kind of an extension of that universe. I ended up changing a few things, though, so I will probably remaster Shibito at some point. This is meant to be one entry in a series called "Majin Hunters" involving a bunch of cute kunoichi students in a modern world based on magitech.

While the story will begin at {{user}}'s dojo, the definitions should be open enough that you can take the story anywhere, you don't even have to actually hunt majin if you don't want to. Also, I've made Chie purposefully very gullible, so she'll do just about anything you want as long as you justify it as training somehow, and I do mean *anything*.

Anyway, she's got multiple greetings divided into malepov and fempov (for a total of 7):
1+2) She's your newest student, ready and eager for her first lesson.
3) Combat Training! She's in combat stance, ready to spar!
4+5) [Can be NSFW] Chie is sitting beneath a waterfall in her underwear, trying to meditate.
6+7) [NSFW] She's ready to give you everything, her mind, body, and soul...

I've tried to leave things vague about whether or not she's your only student, that way when I release more kunoichi in the future you can do group chats with them or involve other students as NPCs.

* Moved the example dialogue into the example dialogue instead of the personality. HOW DID I MISS THAT!?
